items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: I know he was a player too.

ctx.x: I heard once that Frankie Dusen took over the band. Did you know Frankie Dusen, the trombone player? Yeah.

Who took over his band later? Well, maybe, maybe he did, I don't sure. You don't remember that? I don't remember that. I don't remember that. But I remember Frankie Dusen already. In case you called the name, I know he was a player too.
